title: SkillShift-Bench run receipt
description: Provenance for one run, plus a SHA-256 commitment to its per-task results. The per-task file itself never leaves the machine that produced it: only the digest is published. If an entry is disputed, the maintainers may ask the submitter privately for the per-task file and check it against this commitment (docs/results-policy.md).

harness_commit.description: Git commit of the harness, when the run came from a checkout.

env_digests.description: sha256 digest of each environment image used, keyed by environment name (gitlab-v12, gitlab-v16, magento-v19, magento-v24, wordpress). Checked against skillshift-envs/DIGESTS.json.

n_per_cell.description: Task count per (website, condition) cell. Must equal the official counts: gitlab 162, magento 114, wordpress 79.

aggregate.description: Verbatim copy of the submission's `metrics` and `n` objects. CI compares it field by field with results.json.

canonical_form.description: Serialization the digest is taken over; see skillshift.eval.receipt.canonical_per_task_form.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of when the report was generated.
